The spiritual weapon of the country, the ancient black furnace (the spiritual weapon of the country, the ancient black furnace (page 22)) Therefore, it was not until the morning of the second day that Chen Gong paid a visit to Lu Bu alone. This time, he did not offend Yan Zhijian when he arrived, but first reported the battle As a result, he summed it up in a deep voice before talking about the incident in Xuzhou. Early the next morning, Lin Yi woke up from his trance and came to the teleportation array. With a flash of silver light, he came to the main hall of Nongjian Hall. Knowing the longing for family affection in Jiang Junzhang's heart, it's hard for him to still remember the promise he made at that time. He would not pretend to push such a backer out, and Jiang Junzhang did show his true feelings at this time. However, when his arm was cut off, he didn't stop for a moment and hurriedly flew away. As expected by Zhu Xiao, Zhu Xiao's fists punched out hard at Yatis just as he stretched out his fist. When he went there, two huge flaming fists hit Yatis's body. Can he not laugh? This is the land of a state, and now it belongs to him. Not only that, it can be said that the south has been pacified. From now on, he can boldly go to the north. Zhu Xiao got up quickly. The Wolf King and others were leaving, so Zhu Xiao naturally had to get up and see him off. When Li Ziyu heard this, he immediately felt relieved and changed his words. Then he talked about the affairs in the house. Hao Wendi focused on the situation of Grandma Cao and Dong Xuan, so that Li Ziyu could understand more, and then went back. Staring at the sword in Zhou Chen's hand, Tian Xie was astonished. No one was more shocked than him. Understand this sword. This is an absolute battle soul technique that Shayu gathered all his strength. He used all his potential and explosive power. At this time, these black-robed warriors were blown away by Shayu's roar.
